threshold_scope: Engineering screening tolerances, not universal physics thresholds. Near-zero paired differences unresolved using residual/absolute floors; time and vertical grid errors remain unknown.
accepted_step_output: VTU every accepted step for reduced models; weighted diagnostics generated from each state by isolated postprocessor; original ELF unchanged. Full reference weighted comparisons only at its saved frames.
performance: Same sal hardware and original ELF; report differing load and output cadence, elapsed/core CPU separately; historical comparisons are observed timing, not a controlled machine-isolated benchmark.
